events.title: Scenario: AI compute demand concentrates new load on nearby substations
events.summary: Concentrated compute-driven load may compress timelines for transformer upgrades near data-center clusters, creating procurement and siting pressure.

events.title: Scenario: Critical-mineral and logistics signals tighten transformer lead times in Asia-Pacific
events.summary: Upstream material and logistics frictions may materially delay transformer deliveries in Asia, raising scheduling and cost risk for regional transmission projects.

events.title: Scenario: HVDC converter and grid-connection frictions could slow offshore wind ramp
events.summary: Converter and grid-connection frictions may create staggered offshore wind commissioning, increasing the need for interim integration approaches.

events.title: Scenario: Electrolyzer demand signal increases exposure to critical-mineral supply volatility
events.summary: Rising electrolyzer demand could amplify critical-mineral competition, affecting equipment costs and project schedules across hydrogen and renewables-linked markets.

events.title: Scenario: Onsite batteries and modular transformers as resilience response to local grid constraints
events.summary: Adoption of onsite batteries plus modular transformers could be an emergent pathway to bridge grid upgrades, favoring faster-delivery product lines.

events.title: Scenario: OT/AI convergence raises substation cybersecurity focus
events.summary: AI-enabled substation automation may trigger near-term cybersecurity standardization and equipment upgrades, increasing short-term procurement in secure OT.

events.title: Scenario: EPC scheduling risk rises with constrained skilled labor and modular supply preference
events.summary: Labor shortages plus modularization preference could increase schedule dispersion among EPC projects, advantaging locales with modular supply or flexible labor pools.

events.title: Scenario: Battery recycling economics could relieve some mineral demand pressure
events.summary: Scaling battery recycling could provide a meaningful secondary supply for critical minerals, moderating some equipment supply pressures if supported by policy and logistics.

events.title: Scenario: Standards push for modular transformer interoperability gains momentum
events.summary: Interoperability standards for modular transformers could shorten procurement cycles and redistribute demand to standardized, fast-delivery suppliers.

events.title: Scenario: Transmission equipment procurement volatility tied to mineral price and freight swings
events.summary: Intermittent mineral and freight volatility can raise procurement premiums and incentivize inventory or contract changes to manage delivery risk for transmission projects.
